localities.trend_note: Mogappair East rates cited at ~22.6% YoY growth (99acres-derived data); mature planned neighborhood benefiting from Anna Nagar spillover and metro access at Koyambedu/upcoming corridors.
localities.supply_note: Tight land supply in core Mogappair; premium for planned layouts
localities.data_confidence: medium; YoY figure from portal data, may reflect mix change; rental yield estimated

localities.name: Ambattur
localities.price_note: Apartments; Ambattur Industrial Estate area average ~Rs 7,400/sqft
localities.trend_note: Inferred from the listing field: plotted land trading above apartment built-up, plus near-zero plotted supply on the portals, is a scarcity signal in an established industrial-estate suburb.
localities.supply_note: Good mid-income supply; steady absorption
localities.flood_note: Lake-belt pockets (Ambattur/Korattur lakes) waterlog in heavy rain
localities.plot_band_note: IQR of 4 recomputed layout rates (asking) after dropping one outlier. Median ~9,050/sqft. DROPPED: G Square Avante at 5,990/sqft (35.94L for a single 600sqft plot) - it sits 2,500/sqft below the next-lowest comparable and is almost certainly peripheral Ambattur (Athipet/Mittanamalli side) rather than the core. Thin field (n=4) because plotted supply in Ambattur is genuinely scarce - realnest shows only ONE active Ambattur plot listing, with its other three in Ayanambakkam and Thirumullaivoyal (excluded). KEY FINDING: Ambattur land trades ABOVE apartment built-up here, inverting the usual Chennai relationship - a signal of a dense, land-scarce established suburb.
localities.price_band_note: APARTMENT built-up rate. IQR of 8 recomputed project rates (asking). Median 6,800/sqft. Field runs KVR Lake View 5,200 and GP Homes The Breeze Way 5,999 at the bottom to IRIS Horizon 7,940 and Sarang Flats 9,038 at the top. Sarang Flats (95L for a 1,051sqft 2BHK) is the high mark but was retained - it is ready-to-move premium stock, not a different product class.

plot_comparables.layout: G Square Avante (OUTLIER - dropped, likely peripheral)

localities.name: Anna Nagar
localities.price_note: Apartments (resale ~Rs 10,000-15,000/sqft); new luxury projects can exceed this
localities.trend_note: Land is running well ahead of built product: +12.1% vs +6.3% in the last year. That is the signature of a supply-constrained redevelopment market - buyers are paying up for grounds to redevelop, and Anna Nagar has effectively no new land. Green Line metro, schools/hospitals/retail and a deep self-employed buyer base sustain it. Yield 3.0% is an ESTIMATE: general commentary calls 4-6% 'good' for Chennai and lists Anna Nagar among top rental-return localities, but no Anna Nagar-specific measured yield was published, and prices here have outrun rents.
demand_drivers: Top schools, hospitals, retail (VR Mall, Shanti Colony)
localities.supply_note: Very tight land supply; mostly plot redevelopment into boutique apartments
localities.plot_band_note: LAND rate per sqft. 99acres 2026: 24,250-34,900/sqft, average 27,800/sqft. Sub-market split is large and worth carrying: Anna Nagar WEST 19,250-30,850 (avg 26,400), Anna Nagar EAST 32,100-37,450 (avg 35,300) - East carries a ~34% premium over West, so a single Anna Nagar land number is coarse. Portal-published range rather than a layout IQR, for the same reason as Nungambakkam: Anna Nagar is a planned bungalow-plot neighbourhood with no plotted layouts on sale, only individual resale grounds. WEAK CORROBORATION ONLY: the published circle/guideline rate is 16,264/sqft; at the 1.2-1.5x guideline multiple that central Chennai typically trades at, that implies ~19,500-24,400/sqft, which brackets the West average and the bottom of the overall band. Treat the guideline figure as directional only. Land +12.1% 1yr, +31.8% 3yr, +51.5% 5yr.
localities.price_band_note: APARTMENT built-up rate. 99acres 2026: flats 12,700-19,500/sqft, average 15,250/sqft, +6.3% in 1yr. Second independent source (hexahome) gives avg 14,050/sqft at +4.1% YoY - close enough to treat the ~14,000-15,250 average as solid. Ticket sizes: 2BHK Rs 81.5L-1.8Cr, 3BHK Rs 2.15-3.3Cr.

localities.name: Kilpauk
localities.price_note: Apartments; 99acres cites ~Rs 15,600/sqft average
localities.trend_note: Central premium locality averaging ~Rs 15,600/sqft with ~4.7% YoY change per 99acres; demand from medical/professional community and central-city scarcity.
demand_drivers: Kilpauk Medical College and hospitals cluster
localities.supply_note: Land-locked; supply only via redevelopment of old bungalows

localities.name: Nungambakkam
localities.price_note: Apartments; among Chennai's costliest along with Adyar and T. Nagar
localities.trend_note: Split market, and the split matters: APARTMENTS +13.5% in 1yr (a genuinely strong move for an ultra-prime CBD pocket) while LAND is essentially static at +1.4% in 1yr. The appreciation is in built product and redevelopment, not in raw land - so the existing record's 'stable' trend is right about land and wrong about flats. Yield 2.8% is an ESTIMATE, not sourced: central Chennai yields compress because purchase prices have outrun rents, and no locality-specific yield figure was published.
demand_drivers: CBD offices, consulates, luxury retail (Khader Nawaz Khan Road)
localities.supply_note: Extremely tight inventory; occasional luxury launches only
localities.plot_band_note: LAND rate per sqft. 99acres 2026: 22,800-32,150/sqft, average 28,550/sqft; residential plot tickets Rs 6.86Cr-18.5Cr. This is a PORTAL-PUBLISHED range, not an IQR I built from named layouts - and deliberately so: Nungambakkam has no plotted layouts. Land here transacts as individual CBD bungalow plots (only 12-13 land listings exist city-portal-wide), so there are no 'layout + developer' comparables to gather, and I am not going to manufacture any. Corroboration: general reporting places the Poes Garden / Boat Club / Nungambakkam prime band at Rs 20,000-40,000+/sqft, consistent with this range. Land rates +1.4% in the last 1yr - essentially flat.
localities.price_band_note: APARTMENT built-up rate. 99acres 2026: flats 19,100-28,350/sqft, average 22,300/sqft. Independent corroboration (livehomes 2026): mid-range 20,000-24,000/sqft, high-end/luxury 25,000-35,000+/sqft; a third source gives avg 20,500. Ticket sizes: 2BHK Rs 80L-3.5Cr, 3BHK Rs 2.5-5.5Cr, 4BHK Rs 5.5-11Cr. Flats +13.5% in 1yr, +48.7% 3yr, +124.1% 5yr.

localities.name: Adyar
localities.price_note: Apartments; premium pockets (Boat Club side, Besant Nagar edge) higher
localities.trend_note: Rising steadily on scarcity plus Tidel Park/Taramani IT adjacency; sources disagree on pace — 99acres shows 6% YoY on its headline rate but 12.1% on its flat-rate series, so call it high-single to low-double digit.
demand_drivers: Proximity to Tidel Park/Taramani IT hub
Beach/lifestyle (Besant Nagar, Theosophical Society green lung)
localities.supply_note: Tight inventory; redevelopment-driven boutique supply
localities.flood_note: River-mouth fringe streets can waterlog, but core Adyar is relatively resilient
localities.plot_band_note: LAND rate per sqft — REPORTED ONLY, NOT RECOMPUTED. This is 99acres' stated Adyar land range; I could not find a single Adyar vacant-plot listing with both an area and a total price disclosed, so I could not verify it my own way and it does not meet the same standard as the apartment band. Treat as weak. Corroborating direction only: 99acres reports Adyar land +19.5% in 1 yr / +31.3% in 3 yrs. Adyar has just 1 plotted project in our registry against 5 apartment projects, so the apartment band is the load-bearing number here.
localities.price_band_note: APARTMENT built-up rate. IQR of 17 project-level rates I recomputed myself (median 18,500/sqft — which coincides exactly with the 99acres and HexaHome headline figure for Adyar, a good cross-check). Field low to high: Iyra Marvel 12,787 (1,392 @ 1.78 Cr); Khurinji Verbena 13,968; Alda Amogh 15,647; SHDC Sai Virukshaa 15,880; Kriya Winchester 16,500; Sagas Orion 18,027; Sannareddy Sivakami 18,030; Akshaya Sai Subramanya 18,449; Dhurga Jeevan 18,500; Khurinji The Orchid 18,989; Sanctuary x 24 19,010; Vishranthi Ushus 19,130; Rajali Legacy 19,769; Rams Lalith Ananth 20,000; Akshaya Vriksha 20,000; Ramaniyam Anantiya 26,120; Ramaniyam Springs 26,150. TRAP CAUGHT: both Ramaniyam projects publish a per-sqft field of Rs 22,000, but recomputing from size and total price (938 sqft @ Rs 2.45 Cr; 1,004 sqft @ Rs 2.62 Cr) gives ~26,100 — the published field understates by ~19%. Those two are the genuine top of market and sit above the IQR.

localities.name: Velachery
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 9,500/sqft
localities.trend_note: Mature, fully built-out market with negligible new land supply; asking rates flat year-on-year and a transacted average (Rs 10,164) sitting close to the asking midpoint, which signals a liquid but not appreciating market.
demand_drivers: Gateway to OMR IT corridor and Guindy
Strong rental demand from IT workforce
localities.supply_note: Mature market, limited fresh land; redevelopment and infill supply
localities.flood_note: Velachery basin is historically flood-prone (2015, 2023 — Tansi Nagar, Ram Nagar, lake-adjacent pockets rank high risk); elevated eastern/Vijayanagar pockets fare better. Treat low-lying streets as high risk.
localities.plot_band_note: THIN - only 2 plot projects tracked and Velachery has almost no remaining raw land, so this rests on 4 recomputed resale points plus a portal range. Recomputed: MGP Aditri II 2,400sqft @ Rs 1.98Cr = Rs 8,250/sqft; 1,800sqft CMDA @ Rs 1.85Cr = Rs 10,278/sqft; 1,200sqft (Mar-2026) @ Rs 2.2Cr = Rs 18,333/sqft. DROPPED two: a 1,200sqft @ Rs 70L listing recomputing to Rs 5,833/sqft, which is BELOW the Rs 9,294/sqft circle rate and therefore cannot be a genuine registrable Velachery transaction (stale or mislabelled), and the Rs 18,333/sqft point as a single premium/metro-frontage outlier. Floor anchored on the published circle rate (Rs 9,294/sqft, hexahome 2026); ceiling on the 99acres land range of Rs 10,350-14,050/sqft. Treat as indicative, not transactional.
localities.price_band_note: Apartment BUILT-UP. 99acres flat range Rs 7,300-11,600/sqft with average ~Rs 9,400; reported average TRANSACTION rate Rs 10,164/sqft; another source cites Rs 9,500 average. Luxury projects quoted above Rs 15,000/sqft are excluded as a separate premium tier, not mid-market comparables.

plot_comparables.layout: Resale plot, CMDA approved, south facing

localities.name: Pallikaranai
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 7,500/sqft
localities.trend_note: ~7.1% YoY growth per 99acres despite flood stigma, on affordability and IT-corridor access; NGT's Sept 2025 order restraining CMDA approvals within 1 km of the Ramsar marsh boundary will constrain new supply.
demand_drivers: Proximity to OMR and Velachery employment
localities.supply_note: New approvals restricted near marsh (NGT 2025); existing stock substantial
localities.flood_note: Sits on/beside the Pallikaranai marsh; repeatedly and severely inundated (2015, 2023 Michaung); among Chennai's highest documented flood-risk zones

localities.name: Medavakkam
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 7,200/sqft
localities.trend_note: 99acres reports Medavakkam flats +8.1% and land +20.4% in 1 year (land +80.6% over 3 years); Metro Phase 2 corridor catchment plus the Velachery/Sholinganallur IT commute pull.
localities.supply_note: Active mid-income supply; marsh-adjacent stretches face NGT approval scrutiny
localities.flood_note: Marsh-adjacent northern stretches are flood-documented; interior elevated pockets moderate
localities.plot_band_note: LAND rate per sqft. Interquartile range of 5 comparables strictly inside Medavakkam, each recomputed as total price / area: RG Nagar 1,400 sqft @ Rs 1.16Cr = 8,286; RG Nagar bus stop 1,500 sqft @ Rs 1.25Cr = 8,333; G Square South Crown 1,000 sqft @ Rs 73.99L = 7,399; Sumangali Avenue 809 sqft @ Rs 52.58L = 6,499; RealEstateIndia 1,200 sqft @ Rs 66L = 5,500. Median 7,399. DROPPED: Crystal Moonlight Villas 2,200 sqft @ Rs 2.64Cr = 12,000/sqft — that is a BUILT VILLA product, not raw land, and would wreck the top of the band; and a Rs 16L / 1,200 sqft = 1,333/sqft 'Meppur, Medavakkam' listing, which is a different and far outlying village, not the Medavakkam junction market. EXCLUDED as adjacent micro-markets (listed on the same page but not Medavakkam): Iyra Anuhya and MGPs Tuscany (Pallikaranai, 5,349 and 4,650), Akshayam Roheline and VGK Cholavanam (Vengaivasal, 3,800 and 8,009), Brookwood and Amudha Aravindar Enclave (Sithalapakkam, 5,899 and 5,300). Corroborated: 99acres puts Medavakkam land at 'Rs 5,500-7,500/sqft' with individual listings at 6,500, 6,555-6,705 and 8,200.
localities.price_band_note: APARTMENT BUILT-UP rate. Interquartile range of 39 live projects, every per-sqft recomputed by me as total price / flat size from RoofandFloor. Median 6,950; Q1 6,500 (Pushpa Homes / Vijay Sri Sai Enclave), Q3 7,499 (Pearl Evita). Tails, deliberately outside the band: Vasavi Majestica Rs 33.94L / 738 sqft = 4,599 and Casagrand Palm Springs Rs 91L / 1,786 sqft = 5,095 at the bottom (both on the Sithalapakkam/Perumbakkam fringe), Amudha Spring And Splendid Rs 1.3Cr / 1,350 sqft = 9,630 and Vasiyam Pride Rs 1.17Cr / 1,325 sqft = 8,830 at the top. CAUTION on two portal figures I could not reconcile and did not use: 99acres quotes a Medavakkam flat transaction rate of Rs 9,225/sqft and NoBroker a verified-listing average of Rs 10,948/sqft — both sit above every one of my 39 recomputed primary-market comparables, so they are almost certainly picking up premium resale and villa stock. Treat them as an upper bound on the market, not as the going rate.

localities.name: Perumbakkam
localities.price_note: Apartments; 99acres average ~Rs 6,150/sqft with newer gated-community transactions up to ~Rs 9,400/sqft
localities.trend_note: Carried from the prior record (~6% over 1 year, ~20.6% over 3 years); OMR/Sholinganallur workforce demand at a corridor discount. Not independently re-verified this pass.
localities.supply_note: Heavy township supply; wetland-adjacent land under NGT/regulatory scrutiny
localities.flood_note: Perumbakkam-Semmencheri wetland corridor is documented flood-prone (2015, 2023); ground-floor and low-lying blocks worst affected
localities.plot_band_note: Interquartile range of 8 recomputed comparables (Q1 5,312 / median 5,874 / Q3 6,548). DROPPED FROM THE BAND'S SHAPE: a 553 sqft individual plot at Rs 43.23L = 7,817/sqft - a micro-plot that carries a small-lot premium and is not representative. Aashritha at 3,450/sqft is the low anchor and sits toward the wetland edge. NOTE: Perumbakkam land (5,300-6,550) runs unusually close to its own built-up rate (5,600-7,000) - plotted supply here is scarce and premium-priced, unlike the outer belt where land is typically a third of built-up.
localities.price_band_note: Apartment BUILT-UP rate. Interquartile range of 19 projects, every rate recomputed as price/size (Q1 5,586 / median 6,277 / Q3 6,962). Several published per-sqft fields were WRONG and were corrected: Primus at Bollineni Zion listed 6,999 but is really 8,791; Saradeuz Olympus listed 4,600 but is really 6,276; Ozone Greens listed 3,600 but is really 4,200. Primus at ~8,791 is the top outlier - a premium tower inside the Bollineni Zion township. The Humming Tree (4,500) and Hanu Aishwaryam (4,600) form the affordable floor.

localities.name: Sriperumbudur
localities.price_note: Apartments (thin market); the dominant product is plotted land at roughly Rs 1,600-3,500/sqft (DTCP gated plots from ~Rs 1,595/sqft)
localities.trend_note: SIPCOT industrial expansion plus the proposed Parandur greenfield airport; plot absorption is the driver, not apartments.
demand_drivers: SIPCOT industrial parks (electronics, EV, medical devices, aerospace)
localities.supply_note: Plot supply abundant; organized apartment supply just emerging — verify developer credentials
localities.plot_band_note: IQR of 21 named DTCP layouts recomputed as total price / plot size from roofandfloor + chennaiproperties. Dropped 2 outliers: Niranjan Vetri Nagar at Rs 450/sqft (implausible for DTCP-approved land — almost certainly unapproved panchayat land) and ETA Florence Garden at Rs 5,833/sqft (villa-plot product, not raw land). Corroborated by an independent owner listing at Rs 25.58L/1,600 sqft = Rs 1,599/sqft.
localities.price_band_note: Built-up asking rate, IQR of 5 projects across the Sriperumbudur–Oragadam corridor (only 2 are in Sriperumbudur proper — Lancor Harmonia Pavilion Rs 6,004 and Lancor Townsville Rs 2,750; the other 3 are Oragadam). Thin market, as the existing note says. Ticket sizes Rs 25L–1.03Cr.

localities.name: Oragadam
localities.price_note: Apartments/villas in townships (e.g., Hiranandani Parks); plotted land roughly Rs 1,200-2,800/sqft
localities.trend_note: SIPCOT industrial employment (Renault-Nissan, Daimler, Apollo Tyres) plus branded entrants - Godrej, Hiranandani, Urbanrise, Shriram - are pulling a two-tier market: generic layouts at 1,650-2,850 and branded township land at 3,200-3,300.
demand_drivers: Automobile & electronics manufacturing employment (Renault-Nissan, Daimler, Apollo Tyres belt)
localities.supply_note: Large plotted and township supply; end-user conversion still maturing
localities.plot_band_note: IQR of 19 named layouts (Q1 1,650 / median 2,000 / Q3 2,833), the deepest comparable set in this batch. Two sub-market outliers fall below the band and should be treated as non-comparable: S and P Elegance at 790/sqft (4.74L/600) and Niranjan Sangeetha Nagar at 900/sqft (9L/1,000) - almost certainly unapproved or deep-interior village layouts. One premium outlier above: Urbanrise Villa Belvedere at 4,237/sqft, a villa-plot product. Worth flagging a distinct BRANDED-TOWNSHIP TIER sitting just above my Q3 - Ruby Celestia 3,299, Godrej Sunrise Estate 3,247 and Hiranandani Parks The Tierra 3,175 - which is what 99acres' narrower 2,400-3,350/sqft land reading actually captures (it lists only the branded slice and misses the cheap village field entirely).
localities.price_band_note: Apartment BUILT-UP rate, thin evidence - essentially one anchor project. Hiranandani Parkville 2BHK, 1,061-1,075 sqft, priced 54.11L-57.2L: recomputed that is 5,100-5,391/sqft, and the developer quotes ~5,500/sqft. We track only 1 apartment project here and the market is genuinely township-led rather than a broad apartment market, so treat this band as indicative of branded township product only. Independent unbranded apartment stock is negligible.

localities.name: Avadi
localities.price_note: Apartments; ~Rs 4,500/sqft average per portal data; plots cheaper
localities.trend_note: 99acres 2026 shows +8.3% over 1yr, +24.2% over 3yr, +47.5% over 5yr — a real but much calmer figure than the +21.6% YoY currently recorded, which supports the existing caution that the older number was new-launch-mix amplified.
demand_drivers: Defence establishments (Heavy Vehicles Factory, CVRDE, OCF)
Suburban rail and proposed metro extension
localities.supply_note: Growing affordable supply; large developer entry recent
localities.flood_note: Some lake-belt pockets waterlog; core areas moderate
localities.plot_band_note: LAND rate per sqft. Strongest plot dataset in this batch: IQR of 21 named Avadi layouts on roofandfloor.com, per-sqft recomputed by me from total price / plot size at BOTH ends of every listing. Median 4,299; full spread 2,700 (Sri Sai City) to 6,101 (Dura Sakthi Garden). No outliers dropped — all 21 are genuine DTCP/CMDA layout product in the same size class, and the IQR already trims the tails. Krish Classic City's quoted 5,100 recomputes to ~5,245 at both ends; I used the computed figure.
localities.price_band_note: APARTMENT built-up rate. IQR of 10 named Avadi listings on chennaiproperties.com (8 projects + 2 resale), per-sqft recomputed by me from total price / size. Median 6,168; full spread 3,800 (Hazel, Hazel Realty) to 8,037 (MCB Marvel — small 441-535 sqft 1BHK units carrying the usual small-unit premium). Corroborated by 99acres 2026 Avadi flat average of Rs 5,900/sqft. spiritofchennai's 2026 guide quotes 3,800-5,500 and now looks low. Two portal per-sqft fields were badly wrong and I overrode both: Newry Altura quoted 6,500 but computes to ~7,455 across four configurations, and DRA Urbania quoted 4,999 but computes to ~6,135. I did NOT use 99acres' claimed 'average transaction rate of Rs 10,770/sqft' for Avadi — a transacted rate 83% ABOVE the asking average is not credible and is a portal artefact.

localities.name: Madhavaram
localities.price_note: Apartments ~Rs 7,000-8,450/sqft; land guide rates lower per silversky 2025 guide
localities.trend_note: Madhavaram is the northern terminus of BOTH Metro Phase 2 Corridor 3 (Madhavaram-SIPCOT) and Corridor 5 (Madhavaram-Sholinganallur); the first 11 km of Corridor 5 to Retteri is targeted for end-2026. Flat rates already +10.3% YoY and rental demand reportedly +11%.
demand_drivers: Metro Phase II twin-corridor origin (Madhavaram Milk Colony)
NH-16 and Chennai Bypass logistics belt
localities.supply_note: New launches accelerating; still early-cycle inventory
localities.flood_note: Parts of the Retteri lake catchment waterlog in heavy rain
localities.plot_band_note: Interquartile band of 11 recomputed layout rates (median Rs 2,899/sqft land). Every rate recomputed as total price / plot area, not copied. Two traps caught: (1) Aishwaryam Township is quoted at Rs 2,500/sqft but 14.5L / 600 sqft = Rs 2,417/sqft; (2) Silversky Springs is quoted Rs 15,483/sqft, which is only min_price/min_size — its max/max is Rs 9,952/sqft, so it is not a flat land rate and is almost certainly a built villa or plot-plus-construction package. DROPPED Silversky Springs entirely. Branded/premium plotted product sits well above the band and is retained in comparables but outside it: G Square Sarovar Rs 10,499, Premier KVT Rs 5,100, RWD Elite Rs 4,798. i5 CK Madhavan Nagar is genuinely non-flat (Rs 1,932 at the small end, Rs 3,200 at the large end) so both endpoints were entered as separate observations. Portal aggregate of Rs 3,050-7,500/sqft runs above this band because it mixes in commercial frontage on Madhavaram High Road.
localities.price_band_note: Apartment BUILT-UP rate. 99acres reports flats at Rs 7,500-9,600/sqft, average ~Rs 8,000/sqft, up 10.3% YoY. Cross-checks against quoted ticket sizes: 2BHK Rs 65.6L-95L and 3BHK Rs 1.2Cr-1.29Cr imply roughly 950-1,150 sqft and ~1,500 sqft respectively at ~Rs 8,000/sqft, which is internally consistent. A builder marketing page claiming Rs 6,800-15,500/sqft was NOT used — the 15,500 top end is promotional high-rise copy, not a market rate.

localities.name: Manapakkam
localities.price_note: Apartments; average ~Rs 8,300/sqft (99acres)
localities.trend_note: Carried from the prior record (~5.1% y-o-y); DLF Cybercity/L&T offices on Mount-Poonamallee Road plus Metro Phase II Corridor 4. Not independently re-verified this pass.
demand_drivers: DLF Cybercity/L&T and Mount-Poonamallee Road offices
localities.supply_note: Moderate supply; well absorbed by office workforce
localities.flood_note: Adyar river floodplain edge — 2015-type events inundated riverside stretches
localities.plot_band_note: Only 3 organised layout comparables exist - Manapakkam is a built-out office locality with almost no plotted supply (the dataset tracks just 1 plot project). Band is the min-max of those 3 because n=3 makes an interquartile range meaningless; treat as indicative. DROPPED: a 3,025 sqft individual listing at Rs 4.5 Cr = 14,876/sqft - roughly 50% above the organised field, consistent with a premium riverside parcel or land carrying an existing structure, not raw plot product.
localities.price_band_note: Apartment BUILT-UP rate. Interquartile range of 8 projects, all rates recomputed (Q1 7,538 / median 8,750 / Q3 10,601). Published fields were wrong on three: Casagrand Majestica listed 6,749 but is really 8,199; Casagrand Elysium listed 5,199 but is really 6,304; Jains Aadhidev listed 7,995 but is really ~9,100. DROPPED FROM THE BAND: L&T Avinya Enclave Phase 2 at 14,843-17,571/sqft (Rs 1.75-4.5 Cr) - a genuinely different product tier, branded riverside luxury, which would distort the band. That project is the locality's boardroom-segment supply.

localities.name: Kolathur
localities.price_note: Apartments; ~Rs 7,700/sqft cited average
localities.trend_note: Apartments +12.6% YoY with the broader locality appreciating 7-9% annually on Inner Ring Road commercial growth, storm-water drainage upgrades and Madhavaram metro-hub proximity.
demand_drivers: Proximity to Madhavaram metro hub and Retteri junction
localities.supply_note: Steady mid-income supply; infill-driven
localities.flood_note: Retteri lake catchment pockets waterlog in cyclonic rain
localities.plot_band_note: IMPORTANT - the roofandfloor Kolathur plot page is heavily padded with listings that are NOT in North-Chennai Kolathur. I dropped seven of its ten rows (GTK Eutopia Smart City 2,793, New Star City 2,899, Om Lakshmi Nagar Annex 2,700, Aishwaryam Township 2,500, i5 CK Madhavan Nagar 1,932-3,200, RWD Elite Avenue 4,798, Premier KVT Township 5,100) because they sit 2-4x below the verified Kolathur land field - these are almost certainly outer-belt layouts (there is a second Kolathur near Tiruvallur) surfaced as 'nearby'. I also dropped Silversky Springs, quoted at 15,483/sqft: recomputing gives 1.2Cr/775 = 15,484 but 1.44Cr/1,447 = 9,952, i.e. internally inconsistent, which means the price includes BUILT villa area, not raw land. That is exactly the outlier pattern to reject. What survives is a tight, internally consistent field: two named layouts plus four search-visible vacant-plot rates, spanning 8,530-10,499 - reported as the band since n=6 is too thin to trim further.
localities.price_band_note: Apartment BUILT-UP rate. Apartment rates read 7,000-11,000/sqft with an average of 8,050/sqft (Aug 2026), up from ~7,700/sqft in Apr 2026; independent houses command 9,000-13,000/sqft. I trimmed the 11,000 top edge to 10,000 as it reflects a handful of new premium launches rather than the body of the market. localities.plot_band_note: WEAK BAND — READ BEFORE USE. This is NOT an IQR of in-locality comparables. I found exactly ONE genuine Paramankeni listing: a 2,400 sqft plot at Rs 60L 'near Paramankeni Bridge, ECR' = Rs 2,500/sqft recomputed. That listing is Serenity Costa, which is the same project as the two RERA records we already track (Serenity Costa Phase One / Phase Ii) — a useful cross-confirmation that the locality is real and active. A single point is not a band, so I widened it using three villages on the same far-ECR coastal strip within ~10 km: Meiyur/Arabian Hotel (Rs 2,200/sqft), Keelakurechi Main Road / Rathis Kings Palace (Rs 2,999/sqft), and Sadras Main Road / Atirstam (Rs 1,500/sqft, excluded as it sits well inland of the coastal strip). Treat 2,200-3,000 as indicative only and re-verify before publishing. Coastal plots here are large-format (2,400 sqft standard), so the ticket is ~Rs 53-72L despite the modest per-sqft rate.
localities.price_band_note: No apartment market. Both tracked projects are plotted layouts and no flat listings exist anywhere on this stretch of ECR — it is a second-home / coastal-plot market, not an apartment one. Left null rather than copying the land rate.
localities.trend_note: Insufficient data to call a trend from one in-locality comparable. Structurally this is a speculative second-home coastal belt whose demand is tied to ECR travel time and any Cheyyur-area industrial siting; I found no evidence either way in this sweep.
